title: Rack swap shift scratchpad
body:
Night shift scratchpad — rack swap + coloc migration

Shift: 2026-03-11 22:00->02:00 (overnight window reserved)
Location: Equinix SL1, cage B2
Primary goal: Replace faulty R4 rack PDU, perform quick GPU binning on swapped nodes, verify network paths and SR-IOV.

Top-level checklist (high priority)
- [ ] Bring down workloads to drain on nodes: r4-gpu-07, r4-gpu-08
- [ ] Physically swap PDUs (coord with onsite tech, ticket INFRA-2042)
- [ ] Power-cycle swapped blades and confirm IPMI reachability
- [ ] Re-run GPU firmware check and bump drivers if needed
- [ ] Smoke test RPC path to hosted test cluster (10.20.5.0/24) and failover route

Commands / quick snippets
- Drain node: ssh ops@r4-gpu-07 'sudo systemctl stop redwood-agent && sudo -u svcuser /usr/local/bin/drain_node.sh'
- Check nv stats: ssh ops@r4-gpu-07 "nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,name,uuid,driver_version,temperature.gpu --format=csv"
- IPMI power cycle: ipmitool -I lanplus -H 10.10.23.45 -U ADMIN -P $IPMI_PASS chassis power cycle
- BMC flash check: curl -k https://10.10.23.45/bmc/info | jq '.'   (on jump host with creds)
- Validate SR-IOV VFs: ethtool -S eth2 | grep vf

Observed issues / notes
- r4-gpu-08 intermittently loses NVMe mapping after driver reload (seen once at 03/03). Suspect faulty riser.
- On prior swap, the PDU labeled B2 had mismatched phase labeling. Confirm phase mapping physically before replug to avoid tripping feeders.
- Packet drops during high-burst tests on leaf-1 -> spine-2; rate-limits maybe misconfigured on NOS. Opened INFRA-2036 earlier.

Quick plan for GPU re-binning
- Boot to rollout image (ubuntu-22.04-redwood-2026-02)
- Install nvidia-driver-550 and our inference runtime shim
- Run sample workload: python3 perf/bench_tokens.py --tokens 512 --batch 1 --model zed-13b
- Collect latency histogram and tail percentiles (p95/p99)
- If p99 > 1200ms, flag and revert to previous driver

Rollback triggers
- IPMI unreachable after PDU swap
- Node doesn't pass PXE/boot stage within 6 minutes
- GPU driver crashes on first warmup run (kernel oops visible in dmesg)

Coordination & comms
- Slack: #oncall-ops (ping @jin @omar) — use message template: "Rack swap SL1 B2 starting now. Draining: r4-gpu-07/08. ETA power-cycle 22:15"
- PagerDuty: use infra-night oncall if any hard failures
- Onsite tech: contact Ana (Equinix) cell +1-415-555-0199 for PDU access

Outstanding questions / followups
- Can we get a spare riser for r4-gpu-08 on-site before starting? If not, schedule deeper diag the next day.
- Confirm correct mapping for our PDUs in docs (confluence: colocation-rack-change-2026). A few labels differ from inventory spreadsheet.
- Post-swap: run weekly capacity rebalancer to ensure dedicated pools get redistributed.

Notes to self
- Take photos of PDU labels and upload to ticket
- If we see NVMe remap, collect smartctl -a /dev/nvme0n1 and include serials
- Keep an eye on thermal sensors in IPMI for swapped racks for first 24h
